title: Jane Austen Speaks Norwegian
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Can Jane Austen only be fully understood in English? In Jane Austen Speaks Norwegian, Sørbø compares novels and their translations, while also discussing the strategies chosen by translators of literature. Readership: Students and researchers of English literature and translation, Jane Austen societies, and women's studies and reception studies groups.
